title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine got no warning before first wave
excerpt: Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine received no warning from partners before the first wave of an overnight Russian strike on energy infrastructure. Marco Rubio said he did not know the details of the attack.
body:
Marco Rubio said in the early hours of Monday that he did not know the details of the previous night’s Russian strike, as Ukrainian officials said the first wave of the attack on Kyiv came without any partner warning.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia used ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones in overnight attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, according to NBC News and The Guardian. Zelenskyy wrote on social media that “once again, Russia launched a ballistic missile attack in multiple waves throughout the night, and once again, there was no warning from our partners.”

The Guardian said Ukrainian Air Force spokesperson Yurii Ihnat later told television viewers that Ukraine had not been warned before a Russian missile barrage hit power plants in Kyiv at around 11 p.m. Sunday. Ihnat said Ukraine did receive a warning before a successive strike at about 3 a.m. Monday.

NBC reported that Zelenskyy said the nighttime barrage damaged more than 10 energy infrastructure facilities across the country and deprived more than a half-million people of light, heating and running water. NBC also reported that Zelenskyy said Russia fired 16 ballistic missiles at Kyiv and the surrounding region, and that officials in the capital said a 21-year-old woman was killed.

The Russian Defense Ministry said it struck Ukrainian targets including a data center, a logistics hub storing components for drones and cruise missiles, an industrial facility making drone components and a locomotive depot where missiles are stored, according to NBC.

Rubio said Monday that he had no information about the previous night’s attack. The Guardian quoted him as saying, “If it happened last night, I don’t know exactly. I know a few nights ago there was a software problem involving their early warning system.” The Guardian also reported that Rubio said the military’s European Command was looking into the strikes.

NBC quoted Zelenskyy as saying, “Ukraine never wanted this war, and we have welcomed literally EVERY attempt by our partners to bring this war to a dignified end. We have responded positively to EVERY ceasefire proposal.” He added: “The reality is that the war continues, and it continues solely because of Russian strikes and Russia’s desire to drag this war out.”

issues.claim: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Russia used ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones in overnight attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure, according to NBC News and The Guardian.
issues.problem: The Guardian excerpt supports an overnight missile attack hitting Kyiv power plants, but it does not report the jet-powered drones detail. In this source set, that detail is supported by NBC News, not by both outlets together.
issues.fix: Attribute the drones detail to NBC News only, or split the sentence so The Guardian is cited only for the missile/no-warning reporting it contains.

fc.summary: Most core facts match the supplied sources. The only issue is a minor overbroad attribution: the article credits both NBC News and The Guardian for the drones detail, but in this source set that detail is supported by NBC News only.

originality.excerpt-repeats-lead: The excerpt and the opening paragraph repeat nearly the same sentences. Keep the central fact in both if needed, but open the article with a different verified detail or the next development instead of restating the excerpt.

log.summary: Reworked the story around Zelenskyy’s no-warning claim and tightened the timeline between the first and second waves. Removed unsupported background and kept only facts established by the supplied reporting with clear attribution.
